description: This PHP source file defines a database migration class for version 5.8.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It handles schema updates such as correcting foreign key constraints and updating language strings. The class extends an abstract migration class and features methods to manage database schema changes, foreign keys, and internationalization strings.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for performing database schema migrations specific to version 5.8.0 of OrangeHRM, including foreign key corrections and language string updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the database modifications required for migration to version 5.8.0, including schema corrections and language string updates.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Fixes inconsistencies related to 'currency_id' column in multiple tables, including foreign key constraint adjustments and schema modifications.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys that conflict with the intended schema for a given table.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops specified conflicting foreign keys from tables.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Recreates foreign keys that were previously removed to fix schema issues.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object for executing raw SQL commands.

methods.name: disableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks to allow schema modifications.

methods.name: enableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key checks after schema modifications.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance for handling language strings.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database to match the migration version.
